findings.evidence: Mathlib Gamma/Basic.lean:344,439 provides Complex.Gamma_neg_nat_eq_zero and Real.Gamma_neg_nat_eq_zero; digamma_def and logDeriv_apply reduce both sides at poles to division by zero.
findings.fix: Remove hx; split into regular points and poles, using the existing proof for regular points and zero denominators at poles.
findings.issue: digamma_ofReal unnecessarily excludes nonpositive integers, preventing unconditional rewriting of real arguments.

findings.evidence: Gamma/Deriv.lean:217 supplies differentiability under precisely this regularity hypothesis; Log/Deriv.lean:53 requires only a nonzero argument, and digamma_ofReal already handles regular negative arguments.
findings.fix: Replace hx : 0 < x with hx : ∀ m : ℕ, x ≠ -(m : ℝ); use Real.differentiableAt_Gamma hx and Real.Gamma_ne_zero hx in the proof.
findings.issue: hasDerivAt_log_Gamma restricts x to positive values although the same derivative formula holds at every regular real point, excluding negative nonintegral arguments.

summary: Two bridge theorems impose unnecessary domain restrictions.
